Mutations in COL11A2 lead to impaired assembly or function of Type XI collagen. In autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 13, dominant-negative variants cause a dysfunctional collagen that interferes with heterotrimer formation. In autosomal recessive otospondylomegaepiphyseal dysplasia, loss-of-function variants result in insufficient amounts of functional Type XI collagen. Both mechanisms converge on the disruption of Type XI collagen function, leading to abnormalities in the extracellular matrix of the inner ear (causing hearing impairment) and skeletal tissues (causing skeletal dysplasia).

**How to falsify it:** The identification of distinct, non-overlapping sets of causal variants in COL11A2 for each disease, with no shared functional impact on collagen XI biosynthesis, would falsify this hypothesis.
